children.value: A bar salt is a 10ml nicotine salt e-liquid blended to copy the flavours and smooth throat hit of a disposable vape bar. Mejusa Bar Salts Nic Salts 10ml is a 50/50 VG/PG bar salt in 5mg, 10mg and 20mg for refillable MTL pod kits, giving the disposable taste at a fraction of the cost.
What's the difference between bar salts and nic salts?

Every bar salt is a nic salt, but not every nic salt is a bar salt. Nic salt describes the nicotine type, which is smoother than freebase at the same strength. Bar salt describes the flavour style: sweet, often iced fruit profiles copied from disposables. Mejusa Bar Salts Nic Salts 10ml is both.
Which nicotine strength of Mejusa Bar Salts Nic Salts 10ml should I pick?

Pick 20mg if you are coming from a 20mg disposable or a pack-a-day habit, 10mg for a comfortable all-day pod strength, and 5mg if you vape lightly or are stepping down. If unsure, start at 10mg and adjust.
Which devices work with Mejusa Bar Salts Nic Salts 10ml?

Mejusa Bar Salts Nic Salts 10ml is made for refillable mouth-to-lung pod kits using a 1.0 ohm or higher coil at low power, typically under 15 watts. Do not use it in a sub-ohm or direct-to-lung tank, where the nicotine is far too strong.
How many pod fills does a bottle of Mejusa Bar Salts Nic Salts 10ml give?

A 10ml bottle fills a standard 2ml pod five times. At around 2ml a day that is about five days of vaping, a light vaper on 1ml a day gets roughly ten days, and a heavy vaper empties a bottle in three days or less.
Why does Mejusa Bar Salts Nic Salts 10ml taste burnt in my pod?

A burnt taste almost always means the cotton was dry when you drew. On a new pod or coil, fill it and wait five to ten minutes before the first draw, never pull on a nearly empty pod, and keep the wattage low. A burnt pod will not recover.
Is Mejusa Bar Salts Nic Salts 10ml 50/50 and TPD compliant?

Yes. Mejusa Bar Salts Nic Salts 10ml is a 50/50 VG/PG nicotine salt in a 10ml bottle with a childproof cap and nicotine warning, and Mejusa e-liquids are notified to the MHRA. The 20mg strength is the UK legal maximum.
Are these the original Mejusa Bar Salts flavours or the V2 range?

The nine flavours on this page, including Sour Apple, Blue Pomegranate, NRG Ice, Passion Fruit and Star Fruit Kiwi, are from the original Mejusa Bar Salts range. The 2025 Mejusa Bar Salts V2 line is a separate reboot with a different flavour list.
How should I store Mejusa Bar Salts Nic Salts 10ml?

Keep bottles upright, capped and out of sunlight in a cool cupboard, and out of reach of children and pets. Heat and light dull the flavour within weeks, so buy what you will vape in a month, and shake the bottle before each fill.
